entries.name: Ignis Bolt
entries.lore: A needle of fire. It only flies where you point.
entries.hook: Fires searing bolts of flame toward your cursor.

entries.name: Phase Step
entries.lore: The vessel slips between worlds for a breath.
entries.hook: Dash swiftly forward, phasing harmlessly through foes and projectiles.

entries.name: Piercing Aether
entries.lore: A thin ray of stolen sky. Line them up or waste the breath.
entries.hook: Lances through every foe in a line, briefly steadying your stride.

entries.name: Crucible Cull
entries.lore: A hammer of the Great Work, dropped where you will it.
entries.hook: Calls down a concentrated alchemical strike at the cursor after a brief delay.

entries.name: Censer Lob
entries.lore: Heavy glass, thrown in an arc. The air between you and the stain is empty.
entries.hook: Lobs a heavy censer over the horde that shatters on impact, scorching nearby foes.

entries.name: Brimstone Line
entries.lore: A seam of sulfur drawn across the yard. The small ones fear it.
entries.hook: Draws a burning seam of sulfur that slows lesser foes crossing it.

entries.name: Ash Step
entries.lore: Leave a husk of ash. The mites chase the ghost.
entries.hook: Dash to safety while leaving an ash effigy that lures lesser foes.

entries.name: Condemnation Tether
entries.lore: A chain for the proud. The small are ash before the iron locks.
entries.hook: Pierces and incinerates lesser foes to bind the first elite or boss struck with a searing chain.
